title: Q-STD-openfeature: Evaluate goal knobs and kill switches through an OpenFeature provider
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 register entry `openfeature` is planned or partial in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe openfeature
**Status:** open

Expose seed/autonomy/goals.json knobs and ops/halt.json as flagd-format flag definitions and evaluate them in seed/worker/src/goals.js through an OpenFeature-shaped client, so Cloudflare Flagship or flagd can serve them.

**Prediction:** knobs_served_by_openfeature_share >= 1 within 336 h

**Out of scope:** Changing what any knob does.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation openstd --probe openfeature` exits 0.
